mapper.select: select s.id , s.name , s.url , s.is_active_yn as isActiveYn , s.created_at as createdAt , s.updated_at as updatedAt , coalesce(count(i.id), 0) as itemCount from curated_sources s left join curated_items i on s.id = i.source_id group by s.id, s.name, s.url, s.is_active_yn, s.created_at, s.updated_at order by s.created_at desc

select s.id , s.name , s.url , s.is_active_yn as isActiveYn , s.created_at as createdAt , s.updated_at as updatedAt , coalesce(count(i.id), 0) as itemCount from curated_sources s left join curated_items i on s.id = i.source_id where s.id = #{id} group by s.id, s.name, s.url, s.is_active_yn, s.created_at, s.updated_at
select (select count(*) from curated_sources) as totalSources, (select count(*) from curated_sources where is_active_yn = 'Y') as activeSources, (select count(*) from curated_items) as totalItems
